newsitem.title: FRANCE: Relief group says hunger is modern weapon of war.
newsitem.headline: Relief group says hunger is modern weapon of war.

text.p: French humanitarian group Action against Hunger accused a dozen governments on Wednesday of using hunger as a weapon in war.
"Hunger has become the favourite weapon of modern conflicts, the one that annihilates thousands of children in new confrontations," the group's president Jose Bidegain said.
"Humans are sacrificed by those who don't hesitate to use hunger to secure their own power," he said in a statement.

At a news conference, the group said refugees and displaced populations in Sudan, Somalia, Liberia, Burundi, Angola and Bosnia had been starved because "armed movements, governments or rebels created obstacles to humanitarian aid reaching them".
It said hunger had been used as an arm by some governments or rebel groups in order to attract relief agencies and then hijack aid supplies for their own use.

Others had used hunger to win world compassion for their cause or to earn international recognition in exchange for allowing relief organsiations the right of passage to transport aid to refugees, it said.

On the other hand, some governments have denied the existence of famine, such as in China, "to give the impression that all was going well in their country", or in Sudan, "so as not to draw international attention to its scorn for human rights," the group said.
"The governments of some countries refuse to decree an emergency or to let relief be brought to the victims, provoking a disaster that otherwise could be avoided," it said.

It also faulted Chad, where it said government-backed candidates had given out emergency food stocks to buy votes in legislative elections, and Kenya which it alleged had refused to admit in 1992 that ethnic Somalis in its northeast area were starving.
